The '''A/E computer''', '''Analysis/Encoding Computer''', or '''Analysis/Encoding DocuServer''' was an analysis/encoding/translation system equipped as part of the [[Tech 4 PDV]]. It was equipped with a [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]].
